title: AI Cybersecurity, Meta's $10B Bet, and Healthcare Innovations: March 26, 2026
description: Join us on today's episode as we dive into the latest in AI advancements: the state of AI cybersecurity in 2026, Meta's massive investment in a West Texas data center, and the groundbreaking innovations from Qualified Health. Plus, we explore the fierce competition between Claude Code and OpenClaw in the programming assistant market. Tune in for insights that matter!
